[[Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors]] won their eighth title, becoming the most successful K League club which had the most titles.{{cite web |title=Jeonbuk show championship mettle in taking record-breaking K League title |url=https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201101003600315 |last=Yoo |first=Jee-ho |website=[[Yonhap News Agency]] |access-date=29 November 2020 |language=en |date=1 November 2020}} The regular season was scheduled to begin on 29 February and to end on 4 October,{{cite web |url=http://www.kleague.com/schedule?ch=035401 |script-title=ko:K리그1 2020 시즌 2월 29일 개막 |publisher=K League |date=2020-02-03 |access-date=3 February 2020 |language=ko}} but was postponed until 8 May due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |url=https://sports.v.daum.net/v/jq0c0v3qPk |script-title=ko:K리그 개막 무기한 연기..스포츠계 '코로나19 비상' |publisher=Korean Broadcasting System |date=24 February 2020 |access-date=24 February 2020| language=ko}}{{cite web |last1=King |first1=Tom |title=K-League to return on May 8 |url=https://www.sportbusiness.com/news/k-league-will-officially-return-on-may-8/ |website=Sport Business |date=27 April 2020 |access-date=28 April 2020}}{{cite web |last1=Jackson |first1=Ed |title=Socceroos star Adam Taggart is back playing for his club — and he's already scoring goals |url=https://www.foxsports.com.au/football/football-news-adam-taggart-socceroos-news-kleague-returning-after-coronavirus-soccer-in-south-korea/news-story/22b2aa69f5c32c7feb21965bec669928 |website=Fox Sports Australia |date=26 April 2020 |access-date=28 April 2020}} On 24 April 2020, the K League Federation confirmed that they would adopt a modified plan for the season, reducing the number of matchdays to 27 including five matchdays of each divided final league.{{cite web |last1=노주환 |title=[오피셜]K리그 개막전, 5월8일 '불금' 전북-수원전 '전주성'서 무관중으로 열린다 |url=https://v.daum.net/v/20200424151730286 |website=v.daum.net |access-date=3 April 2025 |language=ko |date=24 April 2020}} [[Sangju Sangmu]] and the lowest-placed team at the end of the season were relegated to the [[K League 2]] for the [[2021 K League 2|2021 season]].{{cite web |url=https://sports.v.daum.net/v/20200424151730286 |script-title=ko:K리그 개막전, 5월8일 '불금' 전북-수원전 '전주성'서 무관중으로 열린다 |publisher=[[Sports Chosun]] |date=24 April
